title: Warm Spicy Mexican Freekeh Tacos
description: A pescatarian friendly Mexican dish featuring fermented freekeh, cheese pull, and light poblano flavors, topped with shaved bonito for added depth.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit to roast the poblano peppers.
Roast the poblano peppers in the oven for 30 minutes, then peel and chop them.
Cook the fermented freekeh according to package instructions.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked freekeh, roasted poblano peppers, diced red onion, and chopped cilantro.
In a small bowl, mix the lime juice and a pinch of salt and pepper, then pour over the freekeh mixture and toss to combine.
In a large skillet, warm the taco shells over medium heat for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the freekeh mixture into the warmed taco shells and topping with shredded monterey jack cheese.
Place the tacos under the broiler for 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the tacos from the oven and top with shaved bonito flakes.
Serve the tacos immediately and enjoy.
